content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Government defense, intelligence and environmental services for federal agencies, unlike Grid's commercial digital engineering for enterprises."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Mainly outsourced customer experience and contact-center operations, though it includes some digital engineering."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Software engineering and digital platform services sold to enterprise clients in banking and travel on similar contracts."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Healthcare, higher-education and corporate consulting and revenue cycle outsourcing, not software or digital engineering."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Infrastructure, construction and government engineering and operations services, mostly project-based, not enterprise software engineering."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Designs and sells storage hardware and data management software, a product business rather than engineering services."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Advertising, media buying and PR agencies serving brand marketing budgets, a different business from engineering services."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Sells a subscription customer experience software platform for marketing and care teams, not custom engineering services."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Marketing, advertising and PR agency work for brands and political clients, unlike technology engineering services."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced customer support, content moderation and AI data labeling operations, not software engineering projects."}]}
